en.title: Real-Time Leaderboard Tracking
en.excerpt: How Archeris calculates, sorts, and publishes live qualification rankings to public spectators and coaches.
en.content:
Real-Time Standings Engine

As scorekeepers submit ends from the field, the Archeris leaderboard engine recalculates rankings across all categories simultaneously. Athletes move up or down the rankings table dynamically without requiring manual page reloads.

Displayed Metrics & Statistics

The qualification leaderboard table provides detailed competitive insights:

  • Rank (Pos): Current qualification standing.
  • Athlete & Club: Full competitor name and official club emblem.
  • Total Score: Cumulative points scored across all completed ends.
  • 10s Count: Total number of 10s (including Xs) recorded.
  • X Count: Total number of inner X-ring arrows recorded.
  • Average Arrow: Calculated average score per arrow (e.g., 9.42).

Public Division Filtering

Spectators can tap category pills at the top of the leaderboard to switch between divisions instantly.

Sharing Live Leaderboard Links

Share the public URL archeris.net/tournaments/[slug]/results on venue signage and broadcast livestreams for instant spectator engagement.
